sharedDesign.realRecords: Continue applicable constraints and record-backed considerations. Preserve actual continuous record values when supplied; sourceRefs identify supporting actor/fact/time. No newly invented fixed curve, pseudo-lottery, actor seed or ID ordering.
sharedDesign.uniqueGroundedPreference: Select only when existing supported causal reasons distinguish an option. Preserve reason and record source IDs.
sharedDesign.residualTie: Proposed explicit unresolved outcome with no selected action; caller supplies lawful continuation or pending state. Available-but-tied is different from no-available-option.
sharedDesign.consumerMigration: Every consumer must handle unresolved before its action mutation; null must not fall into an accept/decline binary else branch or first-option/default approach.
sharedDesign.trigger: Reconsider on actual changed source facts, due record or explicit actor/player action; no periodic random retry.
sharedDesign.saveCompatibility: Preserve old traces and rngVersion evidence as historical, append new versioned traces; update type/schema, integrity and rendering for unresolved and tied ranks.
